text.4:161: And of their taking usury when they were forbidden it, and of their devouring people's wealth by false pretences, We have prepared for those of them who disbelieve a painful doom.
text.5:62: And thou seest many of them vying one with another in sin and transgression and their devouring of illicit gain. Verily evil is what they do.
text.5:63: Why do not the rabbis and the priests forbid their evil-speaking and their devouring of illicit gain? Verily evil is their handiwork.
text.89:19: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.
